title: lithocarpus hemisphaericus
intro: Lithocarpus hemisphaericus, commonly known as the Bur Oak, is a tree species native to East Asia. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and boosting the immune system due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Lithocarpus hemisphaericus are attributed to its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its ability to alleviate various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
